text:
leo: Punting a quick Moonstone theme pass into this thread. Main goals: reduce visual noise on dashboards, make code blocks feel "terminal" but still accessible, and resolve a few color-name inconsistencies across tokens. Sharing screenshots in the thread.
anika: Love the terminal vibe, but that amber token for keywords feels too warm next to error red. Could we try a muted yellow (more olive) or move amber to only strings?
maria: Agree. Also we have duplicate semantic naming: `--accent-1` in some places and `--primary-accent` elsewhere. Can we consolidate to the semantic names used in Console v2? (`--interactive`, `--success`, `--notice`)
leo: Good call. Proposal: keep semantic tokens + add mapping file in the repo. Example mapping snippet: 
```:root {
  --bg-900: #07080a;
  --panel-800: #0e1012;
  --terminal-bg: #050607;
  --interactive: #60e1b8; /* actions, buttons */
  --keyword: #d6b24a; /* keywords in code */
  --string: #9ad66f;
  --error: #ff6b6b;
}
```
and a small mapping doc: `token -> semantic` (keywords -> `--keyword`, numbers -> `--muted-number`) so we don't end up with random hexs scattered.
sam: Accessibility note: `--keyword` at #d6b24a against terminal-bg fails AA for 14px. We should target contrast ratio >=4.5 for code that matters. If terminal effect needs lower contrast, use bold weight or background striping to help.
anika: Can we try `#c1a93a` for keywords and `#8b8f6a` for muteds? Also, the hover state for table rows uses `rgba(255,255,255,0.03)` which is invisible on some monitors. Suggest `rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` or add a 1px top border to indicate hover on large tables.
maria: UX copy nit: the theme toggle label currently says "Dark / Light" which reads like a mode, not a preference. Suggest "Appearance: Dark" with a small chevron to open preferences. It's clearer for keyboard users.
dev-bot: color-linter: run complete. Flags: `keyword` token ratio 3.2:1 (FAIL), `string` token ratio 4.1:1 (AA large only), dropdown focus ring contrast borderline.
leo: Thanks bot. Action plan: (1) I'll swap the amber -> `#c1a93a` and re-run contrast, (2) anika to try string->#9ad66f vs #8fd278 in a quick prototype, (3) maria to update token naming docs and add a script that checks token usage across workspace, (4) sam to craft the toggle copy and keyboard affordance proposal.
sanika: small typo in the token doc: we call out `--terminal-bg` but some components reference `--term-bg`. I'll PR a rename so grep is simpler.
maria: Also proposing a small perf note: don't add box-shadow to list items in the A/B table; prefer inner glow on focus only. Shadows end up in the compositor when there are hundreds of rows.
leo: Good. One more visual nit: chart color ramps. Right now the sequential ramp uses mixed hues (blue->teal->green) which makes interpreting magnitude harder. Let's pick a single hue ramp (teal 90%->10%) and keep labels neutral gray.
sam: For tooltip contrast, use `--tooltip-bg: rgba(6,7,8,0.95)` + `--tooltip-text: #e6eef1` to avoid weird blending with backdrop. Also ensure tooltips have role="tooltip" and receive focusable elements for a11y.
anika: I'll mock the single-hue heatmap and push images. Also will test with Daltonize filter for deuteranopia.
leo: Great. If no objections, I'll open the theme PR with the token renames + docs and a small Loom showing before/after.
maria: No objections. Please tag `design-review` and include the linter output in the PR description.
dev-bot: scheduled: `color-linter/2056789012` queued. Will post full matrix once checks complete.
leo: Thanks everyone — will follow up here when PR's up. :rocket:
